English සිංහල தமிழ் Fact Checked All Economy Society Environment Politics Health Methodology About Us Explore Fact-Checking Contact Us Did God appear in Kilinochchi? False A news has been spreading on social media over the past week that God has appeared in Paranthan-Kilinochchi. by Anonymous | May 28, 2023 Reports say that God appeared in the dream of a man living in Umayyal Puram, Kilinochchi last Thursday (25) and told him, “Tomorrow you will see a wonderful sight at a certain place and find great treasure.” Later on Thursday (25) it was said that the man went to graze the cow, during which he saw a shrine of Lord Ayyappa emerging from the ground with a flood of light, and the statue seems to be at the said site. A few related videos are being shared on social media in regard to the above said incident. However, people who visited the particular site said that this was a false narrative. It was clarified that the statute of Lord Ayyappa had been there at the particular site for the the last several years.
